note: ORPHAN Pro 26:19 — so is the man who deceives his neighbour and says, 'I am only joking!'

dims.v: malice masked as humour — deceiving a neighbour, then pleading 'only joking'

the deceiving of a neighbour followed by 'I am only joking!' — the malice that does real harm and then hides behind humour, treating deception as a game and refusing responsibility for the wounds it inflicts, as dangerous as a madman scattering firebrands
the harmful deceit that shelters behind the excuse of jest

ramah (deceive/betray) — 'is the man who DECEIVES his neighbor and says, 'I am only joking!'' (26:18-19); deceit dressed as humour is like a madman flinging firebrands. To do real harm and plead 'just joking' is malice evading its own guilt.
